# gns3_start_nodes (Action)

Sends start to GNS3 nodes in one project. Without `node_ids` it makes one `POST /v2/projects/{project_id}/nodes/start` call for every node in the project; with `node_ids` it makes one `POST /v2/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id}/start` call per node, in sorted order, and stops at the first error. The action changes no state and has no outputs.

Actions need Terraform 1.14 or later. Invoke it from a resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` block or with `terraform apply -invoke=action.gns3_start_nodes.<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Actions need Terraform 1.14 or later.
resource "gns3_project" "lab" {
  name = "tf-example-start-nodes"
}

data "gns3_template" "vpcs" {
  name = "VPCS"
}

resource "gns3_node" "pc1" {
  project_id  = gns3_project.lab.project_id
  template_id = data.gns3_template.vpcs.template_id
  name        = "PC1"

  # Start every node in the project once this node exists.
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.gns3_start_nodes.all]
    }
  }
}

# No node_ids: every node in the project.
action "gns3_start_nodes" "all" {
  config {
    project_id = gns3_project.lab.project_id
  }
}

# Only the nodes named. Run it on demand:
# terraform apply -invoke=action.gns3_start_nodes.pc1
action "gns3_start_nodes" "pc1" {
  config {
    project_id = gns3_project.lab.project_id
    node_ids   = [gns3_node.pc1.node_id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project whose nodes to start. The project must be open.

### Optional

- `node_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the nodes to start. Null or empty means every node in the project, through the project-wide endpoint.
